## Root cause

The icons picker plugin ([renderers/tinymce/src/icons.ts](renderers/tinymce/src/icons.ts)) was loading `@pantoken/components/dist/component-icons.css` into the top-level document to make every icon glyph available to TinyMCE's native emoticons dialog. But `component-icons.css` is deliberately a **lean** file — it only contains the `--instui-icon-*` tokens the component CSS itself references (a dozen or so), not the full ~1,777-icon set.

Since the picker's markup uses the generic `.instui-icon.-icon-<name>` painter (`mask: var(--pantoken-glyph)…`), any icon whose `--instui-icon-<name>` token wasn't loaded resolved to an invalid `mask` value — which CSS treats as "no mask," leaving a solid `currentColor`-filled square. That's exactly the broken squares scattered through the picker in your screenshot: only the handful of icons that happen to overlap with the components' own icon usage rendered correctly. Insertion "worked" because that's driven by the same HTML string, independent of whether the glyph is visible.

## Fix

Changed the bundle to load the full glyph sheet instead:

```ts
export const ICON_BUNDLE_CDN_FILES: CdnFile[] = [
  { package: "@pantoken/components", path: "dist/icons.css" },       // was: component-icons.css
  { package: "@pantoken/plugin-simple-icons", path: "dist/simple-icons.css" },
];
```

`dist/icons.css` is `@pantoken/components`'s complete icon glyph sheet (all icons), while `simple-icons.css` was already correct (it's the full brand-icon barrel). Tests pass; the pre-existing `skins.test.ts` failure is unrelated to this change.
